question: Who among the following physicists invented the voltaic pile, the forerunner of the modern battery, in 1800?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alessandro Volta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alessandro Volta** invented the voltaic pile in 1800, which is considered the forerunner of the modern battery.
 
• The voltaic pile was the first electrical battery that could continuously provide an electric current to a circuit.
